facility.name: The Patch Learning Center LLC
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 718 S COMMERCE ST, CENTERVILLE, TX, 75833

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the investigation, it was found that a caregiver left a hot glue gun unattended within reach of a child, resulting in the child receiving a minor burn from the hot glue gun.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the investigation, it was found that the caregivers present did not maintain awareness of a child's ongoing activity, resulting in the child picking up a hot glue gun and receiving a minor burn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: During the investigation, it was found that a parent was not notified immediately when their child was allowed access to a hot glue gun and received a minor burn from the hot glue gun.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: There was a bottle of disinfectant wipes on a bookshelf within reach of children in one of the classrooms. This was corrected during the inspection when the bottle was moved to a shelf out of reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During the inspection, it was found that an non-routine situation that placed a child at harm occurred in May and was not reported to Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Out of five staff files reviewed, one caregiver was missing six instructor-led hours as well as training in communicable diseases, food allergies, and building and physical premises safety. The caregiver took trainings in communicable diseases, food allergies, and building and physical premises safety during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The most recent inspection form was not posted. This was corrected during the inspection when the form was printed out and posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood: The mood for one of the older infants had not been entered in the Brightwheel application for 5/4/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood (26 TAC §746.2431(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One caregiver was missing a notarized affidavit and a start date in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation's health inspection expired on 2/5/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The operation did not serve milk for lunch during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The parent handbook was missing information on how parents can participate at the center, what weather will prohibit children from going outside, and the HHS website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver stepped out of the room to answer the door, leaving the children in the nap room unsupervised. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver returned to the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The back room was too dark during naptime. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver pulled the curtains back to allow more light in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Antiseptic solution or wipes: The first aid kit was missing antiseptic wipes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Antiseptic solution or wipes (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: The sheets on several of the play yards had pulled loose from the mattresses, causing wrinkles in the sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: There was no playground checklist for November. This was corrected during the inspection when the director checked the playground and completed a checklist for December.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One caregiver was missing notarized and pre-employment affidavits and another was missing a statement that she attended orientation with an overview on abuse and neglect. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregivers completed their forms and the caregiver who was missing a notarized affidavit got it notarized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood: The infant caregivers were not adding mood to the daily report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood (26 TAC §746.2431(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Out of four staff files reviewed, four staff were missing proof of education, notarized employment affidavits, and pre-employment affidavits; three staff were missing copies of their photo IDs; two staff were missing statements that they attended orientation with an overview on abuse and neglect; and one staff was missing a statement that they received the staff and center handbooks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Out of four children's files reviewed, one child was missing a health statement and needed an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Out of four staff files reviewed, four staff were missing proof of education, notarized employment affidavits, and pre-employment affidavits; three staff were missing copies of their photo IDs; two staff were missing statements that they attended orientation with an overview on abuse and neglect; and one staff was missing a statement that they received the staff and center handbooks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Out of four children's files reviewed, one child was missing a health statement and needed an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood: The infant caregivers were not adding mood to the daily report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Infant's Mood (26 TAC §746.2431(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Water Activities: The parent handbook did not have a policy for water activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Water Activities (26 TAC §746.501(a)(15))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Date, Time and Amount Given: A child who was given medication did not have the name of the medications, amounts given, or the name of the employee who gave the medication recorded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Date, Time and Amount Given (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: For the last two fire drills that were done, the children were not able to exit in three minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: A child had medication at the operation that was sent in syringes instead of the original container.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink: The 12-17-month room did not have a handwashing sink.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The parent handbook was missing procedures for policy changes, information on the benefits of physical activities and a plan for indoor activity to occur when weather prohibits outdoor play, information on employee vaccinations, and information on what accomodations special needs children can receive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))
